newsitem.title: USA: Natl Auto Finance comfortable with forecast.
newsitem.headline: Natl Auto Finance comfortable with forecast.

text.p: Consumer finance company National Auto Finance Co said in a statement on Tuesday that it was comfortable with analysts' first quarter earnings forecasts of $0.13-to-$0.14 per share and will release its earnings early next week.

"Our sales volume is ahead of budget, we continue to sign up more dealerships to our program, our programs with our loan referral partners are steadily on course, and our portfolio is performing within expectations," NAFI president Roy Tipton said. ((--New York Newsroom 212 859 1700))
